Message:
Did I...do something wrong?
Something to make Ayse mad...?
Then, I will make it right! So...!

Ayse was shouting
as she rushed towards me.

Her eyes burning as if
an enemy was in front of her.
So, she really...

I shut my eyes
and braced myself.
Then, a pained cry
rang out.

I was scared to look,
but when I opened my eyes...

I saw the dagger I was holding,
stuck deep in Ayse’s belly.

Ayse looked up at me
with a weak smile...

“The two of us...
should never have met
after all...huh...?”

Why are you...smiling like that?
Looking so pleased?

I do not understand.
Nothing makes sense.
I do not understand,
so teach me...Ayse...!

But she did not respond.
Her eyes would not open.
